# AMUSEMENT-PARKS.fun

> A multilingual public directory of amusement parks, attractions and their manufacturers, with park information, photographs and published historical material where available.

Public pages are available in English, French, German, Dutch, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese and Polish. Use the localized page's canonical URL when citing a park. Opening hours, prices and historical material are available only where published; do not infer missing information.

## Park directories

- [English parks](https://amusement-parks.fun/en/parks): Public park directory and search.
- [Parcs en français](https://amusement-parks.fun/fr/parks): Annuaire et recherche de parcs.
- [Parks auf Deutsch](https://amusement-parks.fun/de/parks): Öffentliches Parkverzeichnis.
- [Parken in het Nederlands](https://amusement-parks.fun/nl/parks): Openbare parkzoekfunctie.
- [Parchi in italiano](https://amusement-parks.fun/it/parks): Elenco pubblico dei parchi.
- [Parques en español](https://amusement-parks.fun/es/parks): Directorio público de parques.
- [Parques em português](https://amusement-parks.fun/pt/parks): Diretório público de parques.
- [Parki po polsku](https://amusement-parks.fun/pl/parks): Publiczny katalog parków.

## Reference pages

- [Manufacturers](https://amusement-parks.fun/en/manufacturers): Published manufacturer reference pages.
- [Rankings](https://amusement-parks.fun/en/rankings): Public rankings.
- [Ranking methodology](https://amusement-parks.fun/en/rankings/methodology): How the rankings are calculated.
- [About the site](https://amusement-parks.fun/en/about): Site presentation.

## Agent access

- [Public discovery guide](https://amusement-parks.fun/agent-guide.md): Read-only park discovery and WebMCP usage.
- [Capability catalog](https://amusement-parks.fun/ai-catalog.json): Machine-readable resource discovery.
- [Sitemap index](https://amusement-parks.fun/sitemap.xml): Published localized URLs.
